added.summary: font-palette and @font-palette-values (CSS Fonts 4 §9): a run-time colour font (color true, runtime true) is drawn in the CPAL palette font-palette picks: light, dark, or a named @font-palette-values rule for the text's family with its base-palette and override-colors. The text is drawn with an instance of the font whose colour glyphs the host paints in that palette from the frame after it first appears.
